standard.summary: anima 原生路线的主模型路径。没有它又没填通用底模路径时，配置校验直接报「Anima 原生路线需要指定主模型路径」。
standard.effect: 与 pretrained_model_name_or_path 互为回退：两者都空才报错；预览采样也从这个字段取模型，缺失时错误信息会点名两者。
standard.whenToUse: 跑 anima 的 iLECO / ADDifT / ControlNet 等原生路线时。
standard.avoidWhen: 跑 SDXL 系路线时留空即可；把 SDXL 底模填进来只会让预检更难读。

standard_en.summary: The primary model path for anima native routes. With neither this nor the generic base-model path filled, config validation fails with "Anima native route requires a main model path".
standard_en.effect: It falls back against pretrained_model_name_or_path: only when both are empty is it an error. Preview sampling also reads the model from this field and names both keys in the error when neither is set.
standard_en.whenToUse: For anima iLECO / ADDifT / ControlNet and other native routes.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Leave empty on SDXL-family routes; putting an SDXL base model here only makes preflight harder to read.

advanced.principle: configs_legacy_compat 的模型路径校验把 anima_model_path 与 pretrained_model_name_or_path 合成一个「原生 bundle 是否存在」的判定；随后逐项做路径格式检查，标签写作「Anima 主模型路径」。
advanced.intervention: 配置校验阶段只读不改；模型加载与预览采样在运行时再解析一次。
advanced.expectedImpact: 无运行时开销；填错只影响启动前的报错信息。
advanced.tradeoffs: 字段在 anima-ileco / anima-addift 两个 schema 上暴露，但 anima-lora 等路线同样会读它——不要因为表单里没出现就以为跑 lora 时不需要。

advanced_en.principle: configs_legacy_compat's model-path validation folds anima_model_path and pretrained_model_name_or_path into one "does a native bundle exist" test, then format-checks each path under the label "Anima main model path".
advanced_en.intervention: Read-only at validation time; the model loader and preview sampler resolve it again at runtime.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: No runtime cost; a wrong value only changes the pre-start error message.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The field is exposed on the anima-ileco / anima-addift schemas, but anima-lora routes read it too -- do not assume a route needs nothing from it just because the form never shows it.
